title: caladenia fragrans
intro: Caladenia fragrans, commonly known as the Fragrant Spider Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Western Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and sore throats, due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Caladenia fragrans include its analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in relieving pain, reducing fever, and expelling mucus from the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents present in Caladenia fragrans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
